description: This walk or cycle takes you through Glen Lednock near Comrie in Perth and Kinross. There is a car park in the glen where you can start your walk. From here there is a good country lane heading north to Loch Lednock and the Hydro Dam. The surfaced trail is suitable for walkers and cyclists. On the way you will pass picturesque waterfalls and enjoy some stunning views of the surrounding fells. To continue your walking in the area head into Comrie to visit Deil's Cauldron .
